request.purpose: We are developing new nicotine pouch flavours and want to know which age groups and regions are most affected, to position the products as a 'healthier alternative'.
request.question: How many adults have hypertension, by hospital and age band?
definitions: Adult = aged 18 or older on 31 December 2025.
Hypertension = any condition with an ICD-10 code starting with I10.
Report per hospital and age band: adults with hypertension.
